name: Arrow
description:
A straight wooden shaft is fitted with feather flights and a forged metal point.

Sold individually so native ammunition consumption removes one projectile per shot. A quiver or case is not included.

weight.notes: Weight of one projectile, not a bundle; the 2014 per-projectile weight is retained.

source.title: Devil's Table: Trade & Merchants
source.reference: SRD 5.1 (2014), Equipment; native field mapping checked against D&D5e release-5.3.3. Original description and adjusted weight. See docs/BLACKSMITH_GUIDE.md.
